summary: When everyday life feels uninspired and mediocre despite your hidden potential, it is usually because your **skills are misdirected toward unfulfilling tasks**. To solve this, the source introduces a **pursuit map framework** that plots your daily activities on a grid based on personal competency and energy levels. By categorizing your habits into zones of danger, genius, and potential, you can visually identify what secretly drains you versus what naturally excites you. Ultimately, the guide prescribes four actionable rules to **restructure your time**, helping you eliminate burnout and intentionally invest in the unique strengths that make you truly thrive.
